newsitem.title: USA: Lam Research closes OnTrak buyout.
newsitem.headline: Lam Research closes OnTrak buyout.

text.p: Lam Research Corp said late Monday it has closed the acquisition of OnTrak Systems Inc.

The deal was structured as a tax-free pooling of interests. Each of the outstanding shares and options of OnTrak Systems were converted into the right to receive 0.83 shares, or options, of Lam stock. Lam and OnTrak stockholders approved the deal at special meetings on Tuesday.

James W. Bagley, OnTrak's chairman and chief executive officer, will become Lam's chief executive officer. Bagley will join Roger Emerick, Lam's chairman of the board, in the newly created Office of the Chairman.
